messages:
Priya R: Morning — quick async check from infra/model side. What I did: finished compatibility tests for the 2.1 runtime and pushed PR #4823 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4823). Observed a ~12% token throughput drop on p3dn with bf16 vs fp16 in the new kernel.
Ken H: Nice. Can you paste the perf table? I can eyeball potential regression causes.
Priya R: Sure — pasted summary below. Also flagged flaky CI on cuda10 unit tests (timeout on kv-cache tests).

```
config | mean_tps | stddev
p3dn-bf16 | 185.2 tps | 4.6
p3dn-fp16 | 210.9 tps | 3.1
```

Elena M: That delta looks like quantization path isn't hitting the optimized matmul kernel. @Sam J can you check kernel selection logs when you get a minute? :eyes:
Sam J: On it. I gave PR #4823 a quick skim, left 2 small comments. I can run the reproducer locally after lunch and iterate.
Priya R: Thanks — small ask: if someone from eng-runtime can review the PR today that helps unblock dedicated deploys this week. Tagging @Ken H and @Elena M for reviews. :pray:
Ken H: I can take it after standup, should be able to review by 1pm PT. If it's bigger I may ask for a short design note.
Elena M: I'll do a quick pass for regression safety. If we need a canary, ops-bot schedule would help.
ops-bot: Deploy windows available: today 18:00-20:00 UTC, canary slots at 18:15 and 18:45. Use `/deploy canary --slot 18:15` to reserve. :package:
Lina C: Quick cross-team question — finance needs the throughput numbers for dedicated pricing impact. Priya, can you drop the full matrix to the shared drive? A one-pager CSV is fine.
Priya R: Will export CSV to //drive/infra/perf/2.1-compat.csv in 30m and ping here.
Ken H: FYI — I also noticed a flaky test in `tests/kv_cache/test_cache_invalidation.py`. Opening an issue so infra-tests can triage. #issue-1147
Sam J: PR review ETA: EOD if I find the reproducer reliable. If not, I'll loop in eng-infra to get a hardware repro.
Elena M: Blocker note: if CI timeouts persist, we should disable the flaky test and add a follow-up to re-enable once fixed. Better to keep deploy schedule.
Priya R: Agreed. If CI doesn't stabilize by 4pm PT I'll open the disable PR and notify QA. Thanks team.
Ken H: Ping me again if you open the disable PR and I'll fast-track the review.
Lina C: Also, small ask from product — want to confirm the A/B rollout plan still targets 10% traffic for perf guardrails. If so, we'll prepare feature flags.
Priya R: Yes 10% canary -> 50% -> 100% is the plan. Will document in the rollout doc and link it here.
Sam J: Quick note — I saw a slight increase in memory on the canary logs earlier; will include memory profile in the CSV.
Elena M: Great. Anything else? If not I'll close my loop and start reviews.
Priya R: Nothing else from infra. Thanks all. :wave:
